decision.why: Establish the dataset scope and original-file integrity before choosing an intervention or interpreting accuracy.
decision.hypothesis: The dataset contains paired music images and protected references suitable for measuring melody and chord failures across song groups.
decision.expected_observation: Confirm excerpt counts, song groups, available image inputs and integrity checks; missing files or inconsistent scope would limit subsequent experiments.

observation.label_policy: Recognition sees images only. References are opened by evaluation.
observation.release_limits: Conservative completion guard for this prototype, not a musician-agreed product release threshold. A seven-sample pilot cannot complete this goal. Report measured improvements separately.

model_metadata.billing: Uses existing Codex account; monetary cost unavailable
